_comment: Used when the Vercel project's Root Directory is apps/customer-web. The repo-root vercel.json covers the case where it is the repository root. The two must stay in step, and neither may declare `routes`: mixing `routes` with cleanUrls/trailingSlash/rewrites is rejected by Vercel and previously took the site down with a 403 on every path. Unknown paths are deliberately left unmatched so Vercel serves public/404.html with a real 404 status.
